summary: STRATEX iteration 3 (3D viewer + PDF + relaxed preflight). FULL PASS on backend (18/18 pytest) and frontend (all critical flows). Backend new endpoints verified: POST /api/projects/{id}/scan returns mesh_status='STITCHED' + >=4 anomalies + telemetry and persists scan; GET /api/projects/{id}/report.pdf returns 200 application/pdf with %PDF header and 9.7KB body; POST /api/projects/{id}/launch now accepts drone_battery_percentage=90 (200/complete) and still rejects 78 (400). Frontend verified end-to-end on public preview URL: Landing page renders RoofModel3D canvas (data-testid=roof-3d-canvas) with no console errors; 5-step wizard restructure works (Intake→Scope→Caliper→Vision Mesh Capture→Launch Portal); Step 4 auto-runs scan, populates scan-anomaly-list (6 items), mesh-sf/mesh-sq/mesh-pitch readouts (2799/27.99/12-12), 3D canvas visible, and zero pricing line items on this step; Step 5 preflight accepts battery=100 and rejects 78 via API (400). Mission Dashboard at /mission/{id}: 3D roof model is HERO (y=276) and pricing table renders strictly BELOW (y=2119) — derivation order verified. download-pdf-btn present, anomalies-grid shows 6 items, mission-pricing-table has 11 line item rows. Zero runtime errors on /mission/:id. PDF download works end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: RoofModel3D.jsx (vanilla three.js) cleanly disposes geometry+material on unmount and rebuilds on telemetry shape change. Good. Minor: in tick() the seed-driven sine on anomaly opacity uses g.userData.seed = anomaly.id.length which yields nearly-identical phases across markers — consider hashing the id for varied phase per marker.

server.py _build_supplement_pdf is ~190 lines inside a single function. As the report grows, extract header/agents/anomalies/pricing/summary into helpers. server.py is now 754 lines — close to the 700-line guideline, recommend splitting (pricing engine, pdf builder, ai narratives) into modules.

Launch endpoint still synchronously waits ~90-150s for Claude narrative; user said they wanted 'streaming launch progress' — currently the UI just shows a busy spinner on the AUTHORIZE button. Not a regression but the streaming requirement from the iteration goal is not yet implemented (single POST /launch still returns when fully done). Recommend SSE or websocket for true streaming progress.
Backend /scan endpoint regenerates anomalies on each call (deterministic by seed, so same set), but overwrites project.scan on every invocation — fine for a demo. No idempotency key needed.
